L2 `useTranslation` from react-i18next -> native useNativeTranslationFallback t(key,fallback)=>fallback shim (no RN i18n runtime); the 'dashboard' namespace (L60) is accepted-and-ignored. t keeps the exact (key,fallback)=>string signature, including the CompactView `t` prop contract (L18).
L3 lucide-react Battery/Zap/Plug -> SemanticIcon glyphs 'battery'/'bolt'(Zap)/'charger'(Plug) via getSemanticIconDefinition, rendered by glyphNode (lucide is browser-only).
L4 @/components/feedback EmptyState -> inline native EmptyState (icon chip + muted message), reproduced self-contained.

L7 ./WidgetShell -> inline native WidgetShell (loading -> dimmed skeleton box; else GlassPanel with a title/icon header + DataFreshness pill over a centered body). The web Skeleton/DataFreshness/PinButton/HelpTooltip/QueryError chrome is browser-only and becomes a native-safe freshness pill (relative 'updated' time from updatedAt with Updating…/Error/stale markers + a refresh Pressable wired to onRefresh). The source title='Energy Flow', icon=Zap, and noPadding props are all honoured.

L8 ./shared WidgetFlowDiagram + FlowNode/FlowArrow -> reproduced self-contained as a native-safe flow diagram. The web component is an <svg> (defs/style keyframes, <line>, <circle>, <foreignObject>, <text>) and react-native-svg is NOT a native dependency, so it is rebuilt with RN primitives: an onLayout-measured square drawing area centered inside the body; the same POSITION_COORDS (top 0.5/0.12, bottom 0.5/0.88, left 0.12/0.5, right 0.88/0.5, center 0.5/0.5 = the web 100-unit coords /100); NODE_RADIUS 0.14 / NODE_RADIUS_COMPACT 0.10 / MIN_STROKE 1 / MAX_STROKE 4 preserved; nodes are absolute-positioned circles (% of the square) carrying the icon + an AnimatedNumber(value, decimals=1) + the label (above, or below for position==='bottom', with the same compact 3-char uppercase truncation); arrows are absolute rotated View lines whose start/end are offset by the node radius along the connecting unit vector (identical dx/dy/dist/ux/uy/x1/y1/x2/y2 math), whose thickness comes from the same strokeForValue(value, maxArrowValue) ramp and whose colour comes from the same arrowColor(value, override) rule (override wins; else >0 emerald, <0 red, else muted). nodeMap (Map of id->node), visibleArrows (compact -> sort by |value| desc, slice 3) and maxArrowValue (Math.max(|value|…,1)) are all preserved. The web active-arrow CSS dash-flow keyframe animation is purely cosmetic and has no RN-without-reanimated equivalent, so active arrows render at full opacity and inactive at 0.35 (position/colour/magnitude preserved). The nodes.length===0 branch keeps the web no-action empty-state comment + EmptyState(emptyMessage).
